小写字母、数字和连字符，创建后不能修改。: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; it can't be changed after creation.
只能包含小写字母、数字和连字符: Only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
停用后不再接收新的事件。: When off, no new events are received.
试试用已有的编码 billing 保存: Try saving with the existing code billing
编码用于接口和文件路径，保存后仍可修改。: The code is used in API and file paths; it can still be changed after saving.
结束日期不能早于开始日期: The end date can't be before the start date
填写复现步骤，方便尽快处理。: Add the steps to reproduce so it can be handled quickly.
创建后给关注这个模块的人发通知。: After creation, people watching this module are notified.
PDF 或 Word，每个不超过 10 MB。: PDF or Word, up to 10 MB each.
表单字段基于 react-hook-form：useForm<FormValue: The form fields build on react-hook-form: useForm<FormValues>() types the form, each field takes control and name (checked against the type), validation goes in rules, and messages and labels are Chinese source text translated by the components. Put the fields in a FormDialog / FormSheet, or in a <form> inside <Form {...form}>. Errors returned by the API are not matched to fields automatically: put them under a field with form.setError in onSubmit.
输入框、数字、下拉和多行文本；rules 写必填、长度、格式和范围，提交时校验，: Text, number, select and multi-line text; rules cover required, length, format and range, checked on submit, with the message under the failing field.
开关写入 boolean，单选和多选保留选项值的类型（数字还是数字）；mode:: Switches write a boolean; radio and checkbox groups keep the option value's type (numbers stay numbers); mode: 'onChange' validates as you go.
日期、日期时间、树选择、多选和标签；日期范围是两个 FormDate，valid: Date, date-time, tree select, multi-select and tags; a date range is two FormDate fields, and validate's second argument has the whole form for cross-field checks.
选中文件后立即上传到文件中心，表单里只存文件 id（头像存图片地址）。更多上传用: Files upload to the file center as soon as they are picked; the form stores only the file ids (the avatar stores the image URL). More upload usage is on the Uploads page.
FormCustom 把任意控件接进表单：render 拿到带类型的 value: FormCustom plugs any control into the form: render gets a typed value and onChange, and label, description, validation and the error message work as usual.
FormGrid 默认两列，手机上一列；长字段用 sm:col-span-2 占: FormGrid has two columns by default and one on phones; long fields span the row with sm:col-span-2, and short fields can use three columns.
新建和编辑共用一个 FormDialog，打开前 form.reset；onSu: Create and edit share one FormDialog, with form.reset before opening; while onSubmit's Promise is pending the button shows a spinner, and a field error from the API goes under its field with form.setError.
字段较多，或需要看着后面的列表填写时，用 FormSheet 从右侧滑出，属性和: For many fields, or when the list behind should stay in view, FormSheet slides in from the right; its props match FormDialog's.
只读详情用 DetailSheet + DescriptionList：两列布局: Read-only details use DetailSheet + DescriptionList: two columns, full spans the row, empty values show -, and items can depend on the record.
每个字段写入表单的值，按它声明 FormValues。: The value each field writes to the form; declare FormValues to match.
useForm() 返回的 form.control，决定 name 能填哪些字: form.control from useForm(); it decides which fields name accepts
字段名，按表单类型检查: Field name, checked against the form's type
标签（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Label (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
字段下方的说明（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Description under the field (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
react-hook-form 校验规则（required / pattern: react-hook-form rules (required / pattern / min / validate …); messages are translated
是否显示必填星号: Whether to show the required asterisk
字段外层的 class，例如 sm:col-span-2: Class of the field's outer element, e.g. sm:col-span-2
选项文字（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Option text (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
选项值；表单里保留原来的类型: Option value; the form keeps its original type
原生 input 类型：email / password / tel …: Native input type: email / password / tel …
占位文字（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Placeholder (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
输入框的 class，例如 font-mono: Class of the input, e.g. font-mono
可见行数；可以拖动调整高度: Visible lines; the height can be dragged
最小值（只限制步进按钮，校验用 rules.min）: Minimum (limits the stepper only; validate with rules.min)
加一个「空」选项，选中后值为 null: Adds a "none" option that sets null
选项 { label, value }，value 为字符串或数字: Options { label, value }; value is a string or a number
未选时的文字（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Text shown when nothing is selected (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
节点 { id, name, code?, disabled?, childre: Nodes { id, name, code?, disabled?, children? }
隐藏该节点和它的子孙，例如编辑时选上级: Hides this node and its descendants, e.g. when picking a new parent while editing
设置后第一项可以选空（null），例如「无（顶级）」: When set, the first option picks null, e.g. "(none) top level"
未选时的文字: Text shown when nothing is selected
inline：标签在左、开关在右，带边框；vertical：标签在上: inline: label on the left, switch on the right, bordered; vertical: label on top
多个文件，值为 id 数组: Multiple files; the value is an array of ids
允许的扩展名，例如 .pdf,.docx；默认按服务端配置: Allowed extensions, e.g. .pdf,.docx; defaults to the server's settings
单个文件大小上限；默认按服务端配置: Size limit per file; defaults to the server's settings
没有图片时显示它的首字母: Its first letter is shown while there is no image
图片大小上限；默认按服务端配置: Image size limit; defaults to the server's settings
渲染控件；value 按字段推断类型: Renders the control; value is typed from the field
sm 断点以上的列数，手机上始终一列: Columns from the sm breakpoint up; always one column on phones
点取消、遮罩或 Esc 时调用；提交中不会关闭: Called on Cancel, the overlay or Esc; it doesn't close while submitting
校验通过后调用；返回 Promise 时按钮显示加载，成功后由页面关闭弹窗: Called after validation passes; a returned Promise shows a spinner on the button, and the page closes the dialog on success
标题（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Title (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
底部左侧的内容，例如次要操作: Content on the left of the footer, e.g. a secondary action
宽度（px），不超过视口: Width in px, capped at the viewport
与 FormDialog 相同；没有 size 和 footerExtra: Same as FormDialog; there is no size or footerExtra
打开状态变化时调用: Called when the open state changes
底部按钮；不传则没有底栏: Footer buttons; without it there is no footer
条目；假值会被跳过，可以写 cond && { … }: The items; falsy entries are skipped, so cond && { … } works
sm 断点以上的列数: Columns from the sm breakpoint up
标签（中文原文，组件内翻译），也是 React key，列表内唯一: Label (Chinese source text, translated by the component), also the React key, so unique within the list
值；null / undefined / 空字符串显示 -: Value; null / undefined / an empty string shows -
未选时的文字，也是「空」选项的文字: Text shown when nothing is selected, also the text of the "none" option
